system.description:
You lean into the "caster" half of the hybrid — less committed to the blade, more willing to cast outright when the moment calls for it.

  • Broader Study: Each time you gain access to a new spell level, add one Wizard-list spell of that level to your Magus list (not Polymorph; Haste on yourself only). You still use the Magus's slot progression and DC. Once per encounter, you may use your action to cast a prepared spell normally and, as part of that same action, make one attack with your bonded weapon, which can carry a Cantrip Spellstrike (not a Levelled one).
